grammar.numbers: built on the island's plaza: a % is a glass cube filling with gold, money a coin column, anything else a tower rising floor by floor; the value on a floating white slab above it (a number said while the plaza is taken rides as a small chip, top-left)
grammar.comparisons: two gold coin towers on the island growing to their values, titles and values on white slabs, a gold VS block between them, the takeaway on a navy slab at the front
grammar.steps: numbered isometric steps rising one by one down the left of the island (the current one gold), each line on a floating white slab; the city fades back
grammar.change: classic change cue, old value slides out, new value slides in (MotionTrack)
grammar.lenders: logo on a white sign-board rising on two posts from the plaza, neutral label; a small sign in the chip lane when the plaza is taken
grammar.captionPosition: white words on a navy slab at the island's front edge, English line on a pale slab at the bottom

skinAxes.cover: the floating island city building itself, logo tile on white top-centre, title on a floating white billboard slab
skinAxes.captions: white words on a navy isometric slab with a blue edge, keywords amber, the word being said lifts like a block
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; a floating isometric island city with a drifting camera
skinAxes.transitions: blocks spring up and sink back on the plaza; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: flat isometric blocks with lit windows, a gold-roofed home on the plaza between beats, pale-sky-to-navy gradient, drifting clouds, coins dropping on roofs, slab edges
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
